g.text: Never connect LM2596 5 V output to 3V3.

g.desc: Never connect LM2596 5 V output to 3V3.

g.text: Configuration notes only: firmware has NOT been created or flashed.

g.desc: Configuration notes only: firmware has NOT been created or flashed.

g.text: U1 INT1 / INT2 / SDX / SCX: NC; PA0 unused (poll SPI).

g.desc: U1 INT1 / INT2 / SDX / SCX: NC; PA0 unused (poll SPI).

g.text: VERIFY U1.8 SDX / U1.9 SCX are auxiliary ASDx / ASCx on V1.3;

g.desc: VERIFY U1.8 SDX / U1.9 SCX are auxiliary ASDx / ASCx on V1.3;

g.text: do not confuse these with Bosch chip primary SDx / SCx.

g.desc: do not confuse these with Bosch chip primary SDx / SCx.

g.text: Master, full duplex, 8-bit, MSB first; Mode 0: CPOL=0, CPHA=0.

g.desc: Master, full duplex, 8-bit, MSB first; Mode 0: CPOL=0, CPHA=0.

g.text: Software NSS; SPI1 clock 72 MHz / 32 = SCK 2.25 MHz.

g.desc: Software NSS; SPI1 clock 72 MHz / 32 = SCK 2.25 MHz.

g.text: PA4: GPIO output push-pull, initial High; CS active Low.

g.desc: PA4: GPIO output push-pull, initial High; CS active Low.

g.text: Select SPI and initialize BMI270 per datasheet / Bosch SensorAPI.

g.desc: Select SPI and initialize BMI270 per datasheet / Bosch SensorAPI.

g.text: USART1: CRSF, 420000 baud, 8N1, non-inverted, full duplex;

g.desc: USART1: CRSF, 420000 baud, 8N1, non-inverted, full duplex;

g.text: no hardware flow control. PA9 TX -> RX; PA10 RX <- TX.

g.desc: no hardware flow control. PA9 TX -> RX; PA10 RX <- TX.

g.text: 400 Hz and DShot support are NOT assumed.

g.desc: 400 Hz and DShot support are NOT assumed.

g.text: PWM frequency, pulse range and calibration: match actual ESC.

g.desc: PWM frequency, pulse range and calibration: match actual ESC.

g.text: Two PWR_FLAGs: ERC declarations only; no hardware, BOM or PCB.

g.desc: Two PWR_FLAGs: ERC declarations only; no hardware, BOM or PCB.

g.text: U7: logical module symbol; physical pin numbers / footprint UNVERIFIED.

g.desc: U7: logical module symbol; physical pin numbers / footprint UNVERIFIED.

g.text: Verify BMI270 V1.3 module supports a 3.3 V supply.

g.desc: Verify BMI270 V1.3 module supports a 3.3 V supply.

g.text: LiPo 3S: nominal 11.1 V; fully charged 12.6 V.

g.desc: LiPo 3S: nominal 11.1 V; fully charged 12.6 V.

g.text: Never connect LiPo to STM32 5V, 3V3 or backup VBAT.

g.desc: Never connect LiPo to STM32 5V, 3V3 or backup VBAT.

g.text: USB is NOT the supply; verify DevKit backfeed protection

g.desc: USB is NOT the supply; verify DevKit backfeed protection

g.text: Crossings connect only where a junction dot is shown.

g.desc: Crossings connect only where a junction dot is shown.

g.text: TIM4 default, no remap: B6 / B7 / B8 / B9 = ESC1 / 2 / 3 / 4.

g.desc: TIM4 default, no remap: B6 / B7 / B8 / B9 = ESC1 / 2 / 3 / 4.

g.text: Motor numbers do not define rotation or mixer.

g.desc: Motor numbers do not define rotation or mixer.

g.text: Adjust AND measure LM2596 output = 5.0 V before connecting loads.

g.desc: Adjust AND measure LM2596 output = 5.0 V before connecting loads.

g.text: All four ESC pin 7 BEC/VCC: NC. No BEC or USB logic supply.

g.desc: All four ESC pin 7 BEC/VCC: NC. No BEC or USB logic supply.

g.text: PA13/PA14 reserved for SWD; set existing BOOT0 jumper = 0.

g.desc: PA13/PA14 reserved for SWD; set existing BOOT0 jumper = 0.

g.text: Verify DevKit accepts power at 5V and LM2596 has enough current.

g.desc: Verify DevKit accepts power at 5V and LM2596 has enough current.
